note: clothesColdC and clothesHeatC widen a humanlike pawn's comfortable range until C15 (apparel) gives real insulation; remove them then. How fast heat moves between a room and what is round it. Per game hour, as a share of the temperature difference for each boundary cell, divided by the room's cell count (docs/design/temperature.md). A closed 5 x 5 room with a thin roof loses about 1/18 of the difference an hour.
